name: context-bar
description: Thin bar above the prompt: context-window fill, tokens used this session, cost and plan rate limits, with /context-bar for the breakdown

showBand.title: Show the bar above the prompt
showBand.description: Draw the context bar above the prompt. /context-bar hide and /context-bar show change it for the session.

warnAt.title: Yellow from (% of context)
warnAt.description: The bar turns yellow when the context window is at least this full.

dangerAt.title: Red from (% of context)
dangerAt.description: The bar turns red when the context window is at least this full. Rate-limit windows use the same two thresholds.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show the session's cost in US dollars, as /cost totals it (on a subscription this is an API-price estimate, not a bill).
